events.text: João Cancelo (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Ferran Torres replaces Ousmane Dembélé because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Barcelona. Fermín López replaces Dani Olmo because of an injury.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Barcelona 0. Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by João Neves with a headed pass.
Delay in match because of an injury Willian Pacho (Paris Saint Germain).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Paris Saint Germain 1, Barcelona 0.
Second Half begins Paris Saint Germain 1, Barcelona 0.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Barcelona 1. Xavi Espart (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Fermín López with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Paris Saint Germain).
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Illia Zabarnyi replaces Marquinhos because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Maghnes Akliouche replaces Khvicha Kvaratskhelia because of an injury.
Substitution, Barcelona. Karim Adeyemi replaces Raphinha.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Pedri.
Substitution, Barcelona. Rodri replaces Marc Bernal.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 2, Barcelona 1. Lucas Hernández (Paris Saint Germain) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Désiré Doué with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Barcelona. Alejandro Balde replaces Xavi Espart.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Warren Zaïre-Emery replaces Lucas Hernández.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Senny Mayulu replaces Désiré Doué.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 2, Barcelona 2. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the top right corner.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 3, Barcelona 2. Vitinha (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 4, Barcelona 2. Fabián Ruiz (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Achraf Hakimi.
